$description: Terms that are NOT translated in either the id or en locale. The explanatory tooltips (id/en) are used in WidthSelector, ShankSelector, SizeGuide and product descriptions.

shank.id: Bagian keras di sol pointe yang menopang lengkung kaki. Di Só Dança: Full Soft, Full Normal, Full Reinforced, Full Extra Reinforced.
shank.en: The stiff insole of a pointe shoe that supports the arch. Só Dança options: Full Soft, Full Normal, Full Reinforced, Full Extra Reinforced.

box.id: Bagian ujung pointe yang keras tempat jari kaki bertumpu.
box.en: The hardened toe of a pointe shoe that the toes rest in.

vamp.id: Panjang bagian atas sepatu dari ujung ke bukaan.
vamp.en: The length of the upper from the tip to the opening.

platform.id: Permukaan datar di ujung pointe untuk berdiri.
platform.en: The flat tip of a pointe shoe you stand on.

split sole.id: Sol terbagi dua (depan & tumit) — lebih lentur, kaki terlihat lebih melengkung.
split sole.en: Two-part sole (ball & heel) — more flexible, accentuates the arch.

full sole.id: Sol utuh — lebih kokoh, cocok untuk pemula & anak.
full sole.en: One-piece sole — more support, good for beginners & kids.

demi-pointe.id: Posisi berjinjit setengah; juga sebutan sepatu transisi sebelum pointe.
demi-pointe.en: Half-toe position; also a pre-pointe shoe.

drawstring.id: Tali serut di bukaan sepatu untuk menyesuaikan kekencangan.
drawstring.en: Cord around the opening to adjust the fit.

width.id: Lebar sepatu. Narrow/Medium/Wide atau A (sempit) – EE (sangat lebar), tergantung model.
width.en: Shoe width. Narrow/Medium/Wide or A (narrow) – EE (extra wide), depending on the model.
